scope: Conflicts are other-net copper shorts or clearance violations only on newly spanned layers. Same-net copper contact is exempt.
All trace segments, expanded via/PTH spans, rotated SMT/PTH pads, and pours with inner rings use installed native-check geometry.
Pour copper uses the board pad-copper clearance; the source pour clearance is not serialized. Pours are checked as emitted, not automatically repoured.
Batch-safe excludes both endpoints of any future via-via collision. Run native drill, continuity, clearance and Gerber checks on the resulting board.
Existing-layer defects, NPTH spacing, board edges and same-net drill spacing are outside this conversion inventory; native/supplemental checks remain required.
This is routing evidence, not fabrication or SI/PI qualification.
